Both implementation phases are accepted and committed. The board has 2 Done and 0 Blocked tasks, and both DoD gates passed. I’m now using `impl-review` for the authorized final review across three distinct domains.

The corrected implementation is committed, and all 76 tests passed. I’m running `impl-review` again on the affected date and month behavior. Earlier Decimal and rendering findings remain valid; the reviewers will check the correction and its integration.
